title: ICAI CA Jan 2027 Alert: Final Deadlines for Exam Forms and Correction Window
content:
# ICAI CA Jan 2027 Alert: Final Deadlines for Exam Forms and Correction Window

Ek important update hai! The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ne January 2027 CA examinations ke liye exam form submission with late fees aur correction window ki final deadlines announce ki hain. Students ke liye yeh dates miss karna bilkul afford nahi kar sakte.

Yahaan essential details hain:

*   **Online Application Start Date:** The examination application window opened on **November 3, 2026**.
*   **Last Date without Late Fee:** Submissions without a late fee closed on **November 16, 2026, at 11:59 PM IST**.
*   **Final Deadline with Late Fee:** Aap apna exam form **November 19, 2026, at 11:59 PM IST** tak late fee ke saath submit kar sakte hain.
*   **Late Fee Amount:** Late fee ₹600 hai Indian aur Kathmandu centres ke liye, aur US $10 overseas centres ke liye.
*   **Correction Window:** Mistakes correct karne ke liye correction window **November 20 se November 22, 2026** tak open rahegi.
*   **What can be corrected:** Is window mein aap sirf apni **examination city** aur **medium of examination (English/Hindi)** change kar sakte hain.
*   **What cannot be corrected:** Primary demographic details (jaise name, date of birth, registration number) ya group/paper selection is window ke through change nahi ho sakte.
*   **Submission Portal:** Saare applications aur corrections ICAI ke Self Service Portal (SSP) par `https://eservices.icai.org` ke through hi karne honge.

Yeh notification, bearing No. 13-CA (EXAM)/JANUARY/2027, ICAI dwara jaari kiya gaya tha, jisme detailed schedule aur instructions di gayi hain.

Students ko advise kiya jaata hai ki woh November 19, 2026, ki deadline miss na karein, aur correction window ka sahi se upyog karein agar koi changes required hain.
